set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "07bc0aa1a53a55ff920f1f9ef028c8602fcaa182"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import base64, json, zlib

blob = ""
files = json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(blob)).decode("utf-8"))
for name, content in files.items():
    path = Path(name)
    if path.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"refusing to overwrite existing {name}")
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

cmake_path = Path("test/host/CMakeLists.txt")
cmake = cmake_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
if "rf433_protocol_tests" in cmake:
    raise SystemExit("rf433_protocol_tests already registered")
target = '''
add_executable(
  rf433_protocol_tests
  "${PROJECT_ROOT}/test/test_rf433_protocol/test_main.cpp"
  "${PROJECT_ROOT}/src/climate/rf433/Rf433ProtocolCodec.cpp"
)
target_include_directories(rf433_protocol_tests PRIVATE "${PROJECT_ROOT}/src")
target_compile_features(rf433_protocol_tests PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(rf433_protocol_tests PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)

'''
cmake = cmake.replace("if(UNIX)\n", target + "if(UNIX)\n", 1)
marker = "add_test(NAME stage27_fault_freshness_tests COMMAND stage27_fault_freshness_tests)"
if marker not in cmake:
    raise SystemExit("host CMake add_test marker missing")
cmake = cmake.replace(marker, marker + "\nadd_test(NAME rf433_protocol_tests COMMAND rf433_protocol_tests)", 1)
cmake_path.write_text(cmake, encoding="utf-8")
PY
git diff --check
git status --short

set -euo pipefail
cmake -S test/host -B build/host-stage28a
cmake --build build/host-stage28a --target rf433_protocol_tests -j2
ctest --test-dir build/host-stage28a -R '^rf433_protocol_tests$' --output-on-failure
